XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS Skills Intelligence (AI) — Gap P0.1 MVP schema. Five tables: job — one row per AI skill-extraction request candidate — one row per AI-proposed skill (FK to job), carries the human-review status (the gate) taxonomy — per-tenant CANONICAL skill taxonomy node, only created from an APPROVED candidate impact — skill -> business-impact mapping surface gapfeed — per-user role-vs-held gap feed rows All tenant-scoped tables carry customerid + costcenterid + timecreated + timemodified per CLAUDE.md multi-tenant rules.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_skai_job
TABLE.COMMENT:
P0.1.0 (2026-06-16) — One row per AI skill-extraction request. Lifecycle: pending (created, call in flight) → extracted (Claude returned, candidates persisted, awaiting human review) → reviewed (every candidate has a review verdict) → failed (API/parser error).
`sourcekind` records WHERE the source text came from (scorm | narration | sop | manual) for audit. The verbatim `sourcetext` is kept so a re-extraction with a newer prompt is reproducible. PII screening is enforced at paste time by prompt_builder::validate_source().
`prompt_version` ties the job to a versioned system prompt for safe A/B prompt-quality testing.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to course.id the source belongs to. 0 = not bound to a course.

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — L and D author who requested extraction.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). Derived from owner open_path.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Author-supplied title for the extraction review queue.

FIELD.NAME: sourcekind
FIELD.COMMENT: scorm | narration | sop | manual — provenance of sourcetext.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Verbatim transcript/SOP/narration text sent to Claude.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic model identifier used. Recorded for audit.

FIELD.NAME: prompt_version
FIELD.COMMENT: System-prompt revision tag (e.g. v1, v2-hindi, custom:v1).

FIELD.NAME: num_extracted
FIELD.COMMENT: How many candidate skills Claude returned (parser-validated).

FIELD.NAME: tokens_in
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic input_tokens for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_out
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic output_tokens for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | extracted | reviewed | failed

FIELD.NAME: error_detail
FIELD.COMMENT: On status=failed: short error tag + HTTP code. NEVER includes the API key.

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id who completed the review. NULL until reviewed.

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when review completed.

FIELD.NAME: extracted_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of extraction completion (or attempt on failure).

INDEX.NAME: idx_owner_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Author review queue: 'my extractions awaiting review'

INDEX.NAME: idx_customer_tenant
INDEX.COMMENT: Per-customer / per-tenant cost analytics + tenant scoping

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_skai_cand
TABLE.COMMENT:
P0.1.0 (2026-06-16) — One row per AI-proposed candidate skill. Cascade with parent job. This is the human-review GATE: a candidate is NEVER canonical taxonomy until a reviewer flips its status to approved/edited AND it has been promoted into local_sentientia_skai_taxonomy.
`status` lifecycle: proposed → approved | edited | rejected. Only approved/edited rows are promotable. `taxonomyid` is set on promotion (FK to taxonomy.id), NULL until then.
`suggested_category` / `suggested_level` are Claude's suggestions; a reviewer may override before promotion.

FIELD.NAME: jobid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_skai_job.id

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised tenant root (copied from parent job) for fast tenant-scoped review queries.

FIELD.NAME: skillname
FIELD.COMMENT: Candidate skill name as proposed by Claude (or edited by reviewer).

FIELD.NAME: skilldescription
FIELD.COMMENT: Candidate skill description / what it demonstrates.

FIELD.NAME: suggested_category
FIELD.COMMENT: Claude-suggested category bucket (Compliance, Technical, ...).

FIELD.NAME: suggested_level
FIELD.COMMENT: Claude-suggested teach-to level 1-5 (Awareness..Expert).

FIELD.NAME: confidence
FIELD.COMMENT: Claude-reported confidence 0.00-1.00 the skill is genuinely taught by the source.

FIELD.NAME: evidence
FIELD.COMMENT: Short verbatim snippet from the source that justifies the skill (grounding).

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: proposed | approved | edited | rejected

FIELD.NAME: reviewer_note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional reviewer comment. Visible in audit history.

FIELD.NAME: taxonomyid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_skai_taxonomy.id once promoted. NULL until then.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order within the job (1, 2, 3, ...).

INDEX.NAME: idx_job_sort
INDEX.COMMENT: Render candidates in display order for a job

INDEX.NAME: idx_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Promotion query: select where status IN ('approved','edited')

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_skai_taxonomy
TABLE.COMMENT:
P0.1.0 (2026-06-16) — Per-tenant CANONICAL skills taxonomy node. A row exists here ONLY after a human reviewer approved (or edited) the originating candidate and promoted it. This is the audited bridge between AI-proposed candidates and the production skill schema in local_sentientia_skills.
`linked_skillid` is set when the taxonomy node has been materialised into a local_sentientia_skills row (the production competency framework that the gap engine and sentientia_recommendations read). NULL = taxonomy-only (not yet wired into the production matrix).

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope.

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root — the taxonomy is per-tenant.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical skill name.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical skill description.

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: Category bucket (Compliance, Technical, Leadership, ...).

FIELD.NAME: max_level
FIELD.COMMENT: Top of the 1-5 proficiency scale for this skill.

FIELD.NAME: origin_candidateid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to the candidate that was promoted to create this node. NULL for manually-seeded nodes.

FIELD.NAME: approved_by
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id who approved this node into the taxonomy.

FIELD.NAME: linked_skillid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_skills.id once materialised into the production matrix. NULL = taxonomy-only.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active | retired — retired nodes are kept for audit but excluded from gap analysis.

INDEX.NAME: idx_tenant_status
INDEX.COMMENT: List active taxonomy nodes for a tenant

INDEX.NAME: idx_tenant_name
INDEX.COMMENT: One canonical node per (tenant, skill name) — prevents duplicate promotion

INDEX.NAME: idx_linked_skill
INDEX.COMMENT: Reverse lookup from a production skill to its taxonomy node

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_skai_impact
TABLE.COMMENT:
P0.1.0 (2026-06-16) — Skills -> business-impact mapping surface. One row per (taxonomy node, business metric) pairing so L and D can express WHY a skill matters: which measurable business outcome a gap in this skill puts at risk, and the relative weight of that link.
Example: skill 'KYC Verification' -> metric 'Onboarding compliance pass rate', weight 5 (critical). The impact surface lets the gap feed be sorted by business priority, not just raw level deficit.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope.

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root.

FIELD.NAME: taxonomyid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_skai_taxonomy.id — the skill this impact links.

FIELD.NAME: metric_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Business metric / outcome name (e.g. 'Chargeback rate', 'NPS').

FIELD.NAME: metric_detail
FIELD.COMMENT: How the skill influences the metric — narrative for the impact surface.

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative business priority 1 (minor) .. 5 (critical).

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id who authored this mapping.

INDEX.NAME: idx_taxonomy
INDEX.COMMENT: All impacts for a given skill

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_skai_gap
TABLE.COMMENT:
P0.1.0 (2026-06-16) — Per-user skills-gap feed. One row per (user, skill) where the user's held level is below the level their role/designation requires. Rebuilt by gap_engine::rebuild_for_user() and consumed by the gap UI + sentientia_recommendations (which ranks remedial courses against the open gaps).
`required_level` comes from local_sentientia_role_skills (joined on the user's open_designation), `held_level` from local_sentientia_user_skills. `gap_size` = required - held (always > 0 for rows that exist here). `impact_weight` is the max business weight across the skill's impact mappings, used to sort the feed by business priority. `batchid` groups one rebuild run.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id whose gap this is.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope.

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root derived from the user's open_path.

FIELD.NAME: skillid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_skills.id — the production skill the gap is on.

FIELD.NAME: taxonomyid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_skai_taxonomy.id when the skill maps to a taxonomy node. NULL otherwise.

FIELD.NAME: designation
FIELD.COMMENT: The user's designation the requirement came from.

FIELD.NAME: gap_size
FIELD.COMMENT: required_level - held_level (positive).

FIELD.NAME: impact_weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Max business-impact weight across the skill's impact mappings (0 = none).

FIELD.NAME: batchid
FIELD.COMMENT: Groups all gap rows from one rebuild run.

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_skill
INDEX.COMMENT: One current gap row per (user, skill)

INDEX.NAME: idx_tenant_weight
INDEX.COMMENT: Tenant gap feed sorted by business priority
